Introduction 


It is not easy finding a good rental house as a couple in Bangalore. You need a place that offers security, proximity, good schools, and peace of mind—all at a reasonable cost.


Sarjapur, once a quiet suburb some time ago, is now one of Bangalore's most sought-after residential areas. Owing to its proximity to IT parks, kid-friendly amenities, and reasonable rents, it's no surprise that more and more couples are choosing to reside in Sarjapur rather than crowded city centers.


Things we will cover in this blog:


✔ What couples think about Sarjapur

✔ Neighbourhoods to rent in

✔ Must-have amenities to simplify life

✔ How to find the perfect flat for rent in sarjapur within your budget


By the end, you’ll know exactly why Sarjapur is the ideal place for couples—and how to secure your dream home here.


1. Connectivity & Prime Location: 


One of the most significant advantages of Sarjapur for married couples is its location.


Proximity to IT Hubs & Offices: 


  • Manyata Tech Park (20-25 mins drive)

  • Outer Ring Road (ORR) offices (15-20 mins)

  • Whitefield & Electronic City (30-40 mins)

That translates into shorter travel times and more time at home with family—a huge plus for working professionals.


Upcoming Metro & Road Connectivity


  • Sarjapur Metro (Under Construction) – Will connect to Silk Board and KR Puram.

  • Easy connectivity to ORR & Sarjapur Road – Seamless drives to major areas.

No longer wasting hours in Bangalore traffic!

Housing Options for Every Budget: 


Unlike overpriced central Bangalore areas (Indiranagar, Koramangala), Sarjapur offers bigger homes at lower rents.


  • Budget-friendly apartments (₹20K - ₹35K)

  • Mid-range gated communities (₹35K - ₹50K)

  • Luxury villas & premium flats (₹50K+)ddddd

Whether you’re a young couple starting out or a family looking for space, Sarjapur has something for everyone.



3. Family-Friendly Infrastructure: Schools, Hospitals & More


For married couples—especially with children—Sarjapur has it all within driving distance.


Nearest Top Schools


  • Oakridge International School (CBSE & IB)

  • Harvest International School (ICSE)

  • DPS East (CBSE)

Hospitals and Clinics


  • Columbia Asia Hospital (24/7 emergency)

  • Motherhood Hospital (Specialized maternity treatment)

  • Sakra World Hospital (Advanced care)


Daily Essentials


  • Supermarkets (Big Bazaar, More Mega Store)

  • Fresh veggie and fruit weekend markets

  • Parks and playgrounds (Sobha Lakeview, Rainbow Drive Park)

No more long grocery shopping or doc visits!


4. Safety & Community Living: Peace of Mind Guaranteed


In contrast to population-dense urban zones, Sarjapur presents cleaner, quieter, and secure living.


Reasons Why Couples Feel Safe Here


✔ Gated societies with 24x7 security personnel & CCTV surveillance

✔ Relatively low crime rates in relation to central Bangalore

✔ Active resident welfare associations (RWAs) that take care of maintenance


Green & Quiet Environment


  • Fewer noise disturbances

  • Tree-lined roads

  • Jogging/walking tracks available in most colonies

  • Ideal for couples seeking peaceful, stress-free living.


    5. Work-Life Balance & Lifestyle Perks

    Sarjapur is not all about office—it's about living life as well.


    Shopping & Entertainment


    • Malls: Phoenix Marketcity, Forum Neighbourhood Mall

    • Cafes & Restaurants: Third Wave Coffee, The Black Pearl, Toscano

    Fitness & Recreation


    • Gyms & Yoga Studios (Cult.fit, Anytime Fitness)

    • Swimming pools & sports clubs in gated societies


    Weekend Getaways


    • Nandi Hills (1.5-hour drive)

    • Hesaraghatta Lake (45 mins)

    An ideal blend of urban convenience & relaxation.

Conclusion: 


Sarjapur offers all that a married couple would need—good connectivity, best schools, safe neighborhoods, and affordable rentals. Whether a young couple or a growing family, this suburb is the perfect blend of comfort and convenience.

Ready to move? Start looking for your flat for rent in sarjapur today—your Sarjapur dream home is just a click away!
